merge_flow: Require two successive clear fresh-context reviews of unchanged core.
Add final acceptance wrapper and regenerate outer inventory without modifying core.
Prepare/hash-readback scoped final Git tree; push existing PR branch; update description and mark ready.
Merge with matching reviewed head and verify MERGED state/main ancestry.
publication_flow: Use original audit/preprint/zenodo-deposit.json path and existing repository upload tool.
Stage once/resume saved known ID; inspect exact metadata and uploaded PDF/supplement.
Publish with confirmed existing ID, then inspect published state/files/metadata and DOI.
Record actual confirmed DOI with Google Workspace CLI; inspect duplicate, append exact four-cell row, read back exact range and unique DOI.
Record publication/tracker receipts and target queue DOI on main, protecting all nine accepted core hashes.
retries: Never retry an unknown-outcome external mutation blindly. Concurrent main advances may be rebased and retried by scoped Git helpers.
